title: [YouPass Collect] - The amount of money invested in each category from five organisations
prompt: The bar chart below shows the amount of money invested in each category from five organisations. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the investment distribution across four different categories - Machinery, Building, Staff Training and Research - by five organisations, measured in billion euros.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, Organisation B allocated the highest amount of money in most categories, particularly in Staff Training and Research. Additionally, Building and Staff Training appeared to be the two areas that received substantial investment from the majority of organisations.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the three major investors, Organisation B stood out with approximately 1.9 billion euros spent on Staff Training and 1.6 billion on Research, while its spending on Building and Machinery were 1.4 and 0.9 billion respectively. Meanwhile, Organisation A had Building as their primary focus at around 1.5 billion euros, higher than the amount of money allocated for this category of Organisation B, at 1.0 billion euros. In addition, spending allocation for Staff Training and Research of both aforementioned organisations ranged from 0.8 to 1.3 billion euros.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining organisations, both D and E invested notably less across all categories. Their expenditure on Building was roughly 1 billion euros each, while the figures for other categories were consistently lower, at between 0.7 and 0.9 billion euros, with Research receiving the least funding from both organisations, at around 0.7 billion euros.
